bottom_line: The public build promises nothing: 0 gate findings in 49 pages, 14 chunks and 22 Worker files; my broader net and a browser render of all 45 sitemap pages, cart, checkout and 404 found no promise.
The flag build has one false line, in the story sheet: 'בדף המוצר אפשר לבקש עדכון כשהוא חוזר' for 4 items on hold; the product page has no way to ask (ת56). The gate and the e2e pass it.
The honest replacements are true as a customer meets them (F1, F3, F5), with ת61 on 'כתבו לנו' and the no-access line.

The EMAIL_PROVIDER gate holds: check-config and build-copy refuse mock, invalid, missing, empty, null, lowercase and padded values (G0–G12); with a test provider the email lines and the waitlist form come back (E1–E4).
The hidden form and the consent box leave nothing behind in the UI, but both API routes still accept: /api/waitlist stores emails (201) and /api/checkout records marketing_consent=1 (ת57).

check:promises catches what it was built for (frontend-dev's M0–M7 reproduced 9/9), but 12 of my 36 mutations end as wanted: 19 promise forms pass and 5 honest lines stop the build (ת58–ת60). The rendered e2e backstops the structural splits where it renders that state (SM1, SM2, SM4, SM5).
Regression green: vitest 331/331, e2e 131 + 1 intentional skip (5 load flakes, 24/24 on rerun), a11y 16/16, public-scan 5/5, s18 7/7 on the public build.

findings.severity: medium; before the story layer leaves the flag
findings.what: The story sheet says 'המלאי אינו זמין כעת. בדף המוצר אפשר לבקש עדכון כשהוא חוזר.' (web/src/story/story.ts:382) for 4 items on hold; since S18 the product page has no way to ask. A false line and an indirect update promise; the gate and the e2e pass it.
findings.fix: Move the sentence into site/copy/promises.he.json (e.g. story.unavailable_hint, group waitlist: no_email null, email the line); add the form 'לבקש עדכון' to the definition.

findings.what: The API still accepts what the UI hides: POST /api/waitlist stores an email (201) and POST /api/checkout stores marketing_consent=1 with a timestamp, with EMAIL_PROVIDER=UNDECIDED, in both builds.
findings.fix: In the Worker, emailSends(env.EMAIL_PROVIDER): otherwise /api/waitlist refuses with a code (e.g. 404 waitlist_closed) and checkout stores marketing=false (or 422); tests in api/test.

findings.severity: medium; before master-designer edits the copy file
findings.what: The definition of a promise is narrow: of my 48 promise lines it catches 9; 8 of the 16 forms the task names are missed (נשלח אליכם elliptical, תיבת הדואר ×2, SMS/WhatsApp feature lines, We’ll with U+2019, notified, get notified), and 31 of 32 indirect forms. The same definition guards the copy file: 'תקבלו חשבונית מס.' and 'המייל עם האישור כבר בדרך.' pass build-copy as no_email lines.
findings.fix: A channel rule (a sentence naming מייל/SMS/וואטסאפ/תיבת הדואר/ניוזלטר/דיוור/רשימת תפוצה/inbox/newsletter is a promise unless negated, addressed to us, or a label/error); passive and infinitive forms (תעודכנו, לעדכן, להודיע), ניצור קשר/נחזור אליכם/נזכיר, תגיע/יגיע/בדרך with a message noun, imperatives קבלו/הירשמו/הצטרפו/שלחו לי; receive objects חשבונית/קישור/אישור/פרטים; normalize ’ to '; English notified/let you know/inbox/on its way/sign up/subscribe/email me. Keep tools/phrase-probe.mts lists as fixtures.

findings.severity: low; before the lawyer's legal pages (launch checklist 4.1)
findings.what: False positives stop the build on honest lines: 'הודעת ביטול שנשלחת אלינו באימייל', 'נעדכן את המדיניות מעת לעת', 'עדכנו אותנו' (in NOTIFY_HE: the customer updating us), 'קישור למעקב יופיע כאן כשהספק ישלח את החבילה', 'אנחנו מקבלים פניות במייל ובטלפון' (5 through the real check, 7 of 26 in the probe).
findings.fix: Drop 'עדכנו אותנו'; לנו/אלינו after the verb is the customer writing to us; notify only with a person object or none (not 'את המדיניות'); a third-party subject (הספק) with a parcel is shipping; RECEIVE only in the second person.

findings.what: Structural blind spots of the scanner: <span>/<a> split a sentence (Q1, SM5); JSX children split by inline elements (Q14, SM1) and template literals split by ${} (Q15, SM2); attributes: value, single quotes, aria-roledescription (Q7–Q9); JSON islands other than ld+json, incl. the story's st-data (Q10), JSON files in dist (Q12); CSS content (Q19), scripts outside assets/ (Q17); a chunk the reference regex misses is listed and the check passes (Q18); the Worker: only api/src/*.ts (Q26) and none of the shared/src strings it serves (Q27, SM4). The rendered e2e catches SM1, SM2, SM4, SM5 where it renders that state.
findings.fix: Glue inline elements, split at blocks only; join adjacent JSX text children and template parts with a placeholder; read all attributes with text; parse every application/json island; scan every text file and every .js in dist; fail on any skipped chunk not referenced only by /test/; scan the Worker bundle (api/dist/index.js) minus owner-only modules.

findings.what: 'כתבו לנו' (order.next.delivered) and the no-access line lead nowhere: no mailto, phone or contact link on the site (details 'יושלמו לפני ההשקה'). With no email the order page is the customer's only record, kept in this browser's storage; once it is cleared, the same browser is told 'דף ההזמנה נפתח רק בדפדפן שבו הזמנתם' and has no way back.
findings.fix: Contact details on the site and 'כתבו לנו' as a link (owner, frontend-dev). Wording (master-designer): the received line asks to keep the order number; no_access does not assert the cause and points to contact with the number. Context for EMAIL1/Q3.

findings.what: One switch brings back every email line at once: a provider that sends only order confirmations would make 'נעדכן כשההזמנה יוצאת למשלוח', the §7 delay email, the back-in-stock message and the invoice email false. In email mode check:promises checks nothing but the choice.
findings.fix: Each email line names the job it needs (confirmation, shipped, delay, back-in-stock, invoice, marketing); build-copy shows it only when the provider's adapter declares that job; a test per line.
